SELECT * FROM ( SELECT msv.market_no AS board_no, 'market' AS board_type, msv.title, msv.writer_id, msv.writer_name, msv.content_date, msv.content_status, msv.view_count, msv.completed AS is_completed, msv.completed_date, msv.member_grade AS writer_grade, msv.like_count, 0 AS dislike_count, msv.comment_count, msv.report_count, CASE WHEN cl.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked, 0 AS is_disliked, CASE WHEN cc.market_comment_writer IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_commented, CASE WHEN cr.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reported FROM market_summary_view msv LEFT JOIN market_like_tbl cl ON msv.market_no = cl.market_no AND cl.member_id = #{memberId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT market_no, MAX(market_comment_writer) AS market_comment_writer FROM market_comment_tbl WHERE market_comment_writer = #{memberId} GROUP BY market_no ) cc ON msv.market_no = cc.market_no LEFT JOIN market_report_tbl cr ON msv.market_no = cr.market_no AND cr.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM market_like_tbl mkl WHERE mkl.market_no = msv.market_no AND mkl.member_id = #{memberId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM market_report_tbl mkr WHERE mkr.market_no = msv.market_no AND mkr.member_id = #{memberId} )
UNION ALL
SELECT csv.community_no AS board_no, 'community' AS board_type, csv.title, csv.writer_id, csv.writer_name, csv.content_date, csv.content_status, csv.view_count, NULL AS is_completed, NULL AS completed_date, csv.member_grade AS writer_grade, csv.like_count, csv.dislike_count, csv.comment_count, csv.report_count, CASE WHEN cl.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_liked, CASE WHEN cd.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_disliked, CASE WHEN cc.community_comment_writer IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_commented, CASE WHEN cr.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reported FROM community_summary_view csv LEFT JOIN community_like_tbl cl ON csv.community_no = cl.community_no AND cl.member_id = #{memberId} LEFT JOIN community_dislike_tbl cd ON csv.community_no = cd.community_no AND cd.member_id = #{memberId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT community_no, MAX(community_comment_writer) AS community_comment_writer FROM community_comment_tbl WHERE community_comment_writer = #{memberId} GROUP BY community_no ) cc ON csv.community_no = cc.community_no LEFT JOIN community_report_tbl cr ON csv.community_no = cr.community_no AND cr.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_like_tbl cml WHERE cml.community_no = csv.community_no AND cml.member_id = #{memberId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_dislike_tbl cmd WHERE cmd.community_no = csv.community_no AND cmd.member_id = #{memberId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_report_tbl cmr WHERE cmr.community_no = csv.community_no AND cmr.member_id = #{memberId} ) ) AS combined
content_status != 3 AND is_liked = 1 AND is_disliked = 1 AND is_reported = 1

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM date_series WHERE n < 13 ), date_list AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL n DAY), '%m-%d') AS today FROM date_series ) SELECT d.today, IFNULL(t.community_count, 0) AS community_count, IFNULL(t.market_count, 0) AS market_count FROM date_list d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT today, SUM(community_count) AS community_count, SUM(market_count) AS market_count FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(community_date, '%m-%d') AS today, COUNT(*) AS community_count, 0 AS market_count FROM community_tbl WHERE community_writer = #{memberId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(community_date, '%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(market_date, '%m-%d') AS today, 0 AS community_count, COUNT(*) AS market_count FROM market_tbl WHERE market_writer = #{memberId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(market_date, '%m-%d') ) AS temp GROUP BY today ) t ON d.today = t.today ORDER BY d.today

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.like_count DESC, t.post_date DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT c.community_no, c.community_title, 0 AS market_no, '' AS market_title, c.view_count, COUNT(cl.member_id) AS like_count, c.community_date AS post_date FROM community_tbl c LEFT JOIN community_like_tbl cl ON c.community_no = cl.community_no WHERE c.community_writer = #{memberId} GROUP BY c.community_no, c.community_title, c.view_count, c.community_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS community_no, '' AS community_title, m.market_no, m.market_title, m.view_count, COUNT(ml.member_id) AS like_count, m.market_date AS post_date FROM market_tbl m LEFT JOIN market_like_tbl ml ON m.market_no = ml.market_no WHERE m.market_writer = #{memberId} GROUP BY m.market_no, m.market_title, m.view_count, m.market_date ) AS t ) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 3
